Subject: Kickoff scheduling & run-of-show draft

Hi Samantha / Carlos —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. We want to get your kickoff scheduled and make sure the right cross-functional folks are on the invite. Proposed slots next week (all in PT):

- Tue, Apr 27 — 10:00–11:00am PT
- Tue, Apr 27 — 2:00–3:00pm PT
- Wed, Apr 28 — 9:00–10:00am PT

Draft run-of-show (30–60min depending on attendees):
1) 10m — Introductions & success goals (exec + PM)
2) 15m — Implementation scope & timeline (Redwood PM + Novamed PM)
3) 15m — Technical access, SSO & data flows (Eng leads)
4) 10m — Next steps, owners, and riskiest assumptions

Could you confirm which slot works and share the attendee list (roles preferred: exec sponsor, product owner, security contact, engineering lead, SRE/support)? We can host hybrid — we’ll provide Zoom + a small conference room at our SF office if you want onsite representation (we can reserve if you confirm).

I attached a short agenda and an attendee roster template to fill out.

Thanks — will align internal owners once we get your attendee list.

—Grace
